label: H.R. 2189
title: To modernize Federal firearms laws to account for advancements in technology and less-than-lethal weapons, and for other purposes.

items.item: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives
items.snippet: The bill also requires the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives to determine whether a device satisfies the definition of a less-than-lethal projectile device within 90 days of a request.
